_about: Public-domain Samuel Wilberforce (1805-1873, Bishop of Oxford and of Winchester) for the Word Hoard: Agathos (fourth edition, 1841), The Rocky Island (tenth edition, 1849), A History of the Protestant Episcopal Church in America (1844), Sermons (fifth edition, 1849) and Heroes of Hebrew History (fifth edition, 1874), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Written in English. Not his father William Wilberforce, who has his own shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
